target: kau shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi/ / kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ gsol bar byed pa de ches bsod nams mang du skyed do/ / kau shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta yang zhog gi / bcom ldan 'das gang yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gA'i klung gi bye ma kau shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi / kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu'am/

target: de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / / 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pas ni ma yin no zhes bya ba ni bstod pa tsam bdun pa yin no/ /
src_sentence: na tv eva jāmbudvīpakān sattvān daśasu kuśaleṣu karmapatheṣu pratiṣṭhāpya. iti saptamī stutimātrā

target: dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag kyang pha rol du phyin pa drug po 'di dag don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par ston par 'gyur te/ nang stong pa nyid la mos pa mang bar 'gyur/ 'di'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa don dang ldan yi ge dang ldan par ston par 'gyur te/
src_sentence: kṣāntipāramitāṃ śīlapāramitāṃ dānapāramitāṃ sārthāṃ savyañjanām upadekṣyanti. tathā

target: chos bstan pa 'di la gang su yang sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ / chos bstan pa 'di la su yang sbyin gnas su 'gyur ba yang ma mchis lags so/ / chos bstan pa 'di la ni gang sus kyang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ma mchis so zhes bya ba ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dbang du byas pa yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa ste gsum pa'o/ / 'di dag gis ni thams cad shes pa nyid gsungs so/ /
